## Market Structure & Technical Context

CADJPY shows a textbook breakout from a congested S/R level at 112.41, supported by 16 historical touches that confirm the significance of the pivot. The short-term H1 trend displays a constructive bullish alignment, with the EMA20 at 112.35 hovering cleanly above the EMA50 at 112.33. CFD physics registers a laminar congestion flow regime, confirming orderly buying interest rather than erratic spikes.

Momentum indicators remain healthy, with RSI printing 52.2%—leaving ample room for upside expansion toward the algorithmic take-profit target before reaching overbought territory. With an ATR of 0.11, the tight 1.4x ATR stop loss placement at 112.29 provides an optimal 1:1.7 risk-to-reward ratio for short-term intraday positioning.

## Key Levels

- **Resistance**: 112.74 (Algorithm Take Profit target)
- **Support**: 112.29 (Stop Loss level) / 112.13 (Prior Swing Low)

## Invalidation Level

A break and close below the 112.29 stop loss level invalidates the breakout structure and signals a potential mean-reversion back into the prior range.

## Macro & Flow Context

Global risk sentiment remains relatively steady, underpinning commodity-linked currencies against the Japanese Yen while technical order flow points to continued upside continuation on the H1 timeframe.
